in_hebrew.name: אלישע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלישע הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא המושיע שלי'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים, ו'ישע' שפירושו מושיע. השם אלישע הוא מקביל לשם היווני 'Ελισαῖος' (אליסאיוס) ולשם הלטיני 'Eliseus'. השם אלישע מוזכר בתנ'ך כנביא חשוב שהחליף את אליהו ופעל בימי מלך ישראל יהורם.

in_greek.name: Ελισαῖος
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρ μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ελισαῖος (אליסאיוס) είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος אלישע. Προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'ἐλ' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'σαῖος' που σημαίνει σωτήρ. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Ελισαῖος συνδέεται με την παράδοση του προφήτη Eliseo, που αναφέρεται στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Eliseus
in_latin.long_meaning: Eliseus est nomen Hebraeum quod significat 'Deus est salvator meus'. Est compositum ex duobus verbis: 'Deus' quod est Deus, et 'salvator' quod est salvator. Nomen Eliseus in Biblia sacra invenitur ut propheta qui sub regno Israelitico floruit.

in_english.name: Eliseo
in_english.long_meaning: Eliseo is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew name אלישע (Elisha), meaning 'God is my savior'. It is composed of two words: 'El' meaning God and 'yasha' meaning to save. Eliseo is the Spanish and Italian form of the name Elisha, who was a prophet in the Old Testament. The name has been adopted into various cultures and is often associated with qualities of leadership, spirituality, and devotion.

biblical_reference.note: Elisha was a prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles during his ministry.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eliseo has a strong cultural significance within the Christian faith. This name was widely used among the ancient Hebrews and later adopted by the early Christians. The name continues to be celebrated and revered in the Catholic Church, particularly in Spain and Latin America.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eliseo holds deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It serves as a reminder of our faith and our relationship with God. It is a testament to our belief that God is always with us, and we can turn to Him in times of need for guidance, strength, and healing.

historical_references.reference: Eliseo is mentioned in the New Testament as the prophet who restored the son of the widow of Zarephath to life.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Eliseo remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Michael Eliseo in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Eliseo, which means "God is my God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
